newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH ALLIANZ-BGZ INSURER TO SET OFF IN Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: POLISH ALLIANZ-BGZ INSURER TO SET OFF IN Q1 1997.

text.p: Polish insurer Allianz BGZ Polska SA, which was granted a non-life licence last month, will start operating in the first quarter of 1997, the president of one of the firm's main shareholders told a news conference on Friday.

"We will start our operations in the first quarter of next year," said president of Polish Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej (BGZ) Jaroslaw Biernacki, adding the firm would provide car, transport, accident and other non-life insurances.
Poland's large agriculture bank BGZ has 51-percent of votes in Allianz BGZ Polska, although German's Allianz AG Holding has put up more than half of the share capital.
He also said Allianz BGZ Polska SA also applied to the finance ministry for a licence for a life-insurance company.
Allianz BGZ has a share capital of 14 million zlotys.
